name: Health Sciences Integrated PhD Program (HSIP)
summary: Interdisciplinary doctoral training in health sciences.
detailsNote: Fall 2027 deadline confirmed. Admission model is not explicitly stated on the accessible admissions pages.

deadlines.label: 2027 cohort application and all materials
deadlines.note: Cohort 2027 page updated September 25, 2026 states Tuesday December 1 at 11:59 PM CST.

english.note: MET minimum 61. Duolingo and TOEFL Essentials not accepted. English-instructed accredited degree may satisfy the requirement; scores valid for two years before matriculation. See Graduate School waiver rules. Use the HSIP TOEFL Waiver Confirmation Request Form to verify the institution.

applicationFee.note: Graduate School waivers require U.S. citizenship or permanent residency and qualifying eligibility; limited and first come, first served. No additional program waivers.

documents: Personal statement (125–250 words), distinct from academic statement
Unofficial transcripts from all postsecondary institutions
Research writing sample (30 pages maximum); identify individual contribution to coauthored work
requirements.note: Recommendations confidential; applicants must waive access. WES evaluation encouraged, not required. Biostatistics requires a year of calculus including multivariable calculus and a semester/quarter of linear algebra. Medical Imaging expects undergraduate engineering, physics, advanced mathematics or related coursework. Master's degree and prior faculty contact not required.

funding.note: All admitted students receive five years of tuition coverage, stipend and student health insurance, conditional on satisfactory progress. Funding generally changes to a primary research advisor or external award after quarter six; some federal grants exclude international students.
